# Routes covered by the cluster integration suite.
#
# This file is the contract between two tests:
#
#   pkg/http/route_coverage_test.go              (no build tag — runs in default CI)
#     fails when a registered route is MISSING here, or when a line here refers to
#     a route that no longer exists.
#
#   pkg/proxy/systemtest/cluster_e2e_api_test.go (TestClusterE2E_FullAPI)
#     fails when a line here was never actually called during the run.
#
# So a new endpoint cannot ship without integration coverage, and a line cannot be
# added here to silence the guard without a case that really exercises it.
#
# Format: "METHOD /path" using gin's route template (":name", "*wildcard").
# Get the authoritative list from:
#   go test ./pkg/http -run TestRouteCoverage_EveryRoute -v
#
# Run the integration suite with:
#   go test ./pkg/proxy/systemtest -tags=integration -run TestClusterE2E -v -timeout 20m

# --- public (no authentication) ---
POST /api/login
POST /api/authHysteria2
GET /sub
GET /help/*relativePath

# --- authenticated user scope ---
GET /api/status
GET /api/user
GET /api/profile
POST /api/logout
POST /api/rotateInboundPort
POST /api/rotateAllPorts
POST /api/user/reset-token
PUT /api/profile/password

# --- admin scope: users ---
POST /api/user
PUT /api/user
DELETE /api/user
POST /api/user/reset
POST /api/user/reset-traffic
PUT /api/user/:name/role
PUT /api/user/:name/bandwidth
PUT /api/user/:name/client-limit

# --- admin scope: inbounds ---
GET /api/inbound
POST /api/inbound
GET /api/inbounds
DELETE /api/inbounds
POST /api/inbound/fast

# --- admin scope: certificates ---
GET /api/getCerts
POST /api/cert
POST /api/cert/transfer
DELETE /api/cert

# --- admin scope: cluster / node control ---
GET /api/node
GET /api/containers
GET /api/metrics
PUT /api/gateway
PUT /api/pingCheck
POST /api/update
POST /api/copyUserBetweenNodes
GET /api/node/:name/groups
PUT /api/node/:name/groups
